reviews.title: Great case! Outstanding Support
reviews.comment: It's a great case at a good price. The design is what you expect from a dual chamber layout, but they take care of the details. All the panel feel strong and easy to remove and put back in place.  Plenty of room for everything! My big CPU cooler fits wells. The cable management is easy, even you can do it without removing the air duct partition. The accessories kit included is good, you won't need anything else. The cooling is good just using 3 120mm fans on the side and one 140mm fan in the rear. The only thing they could improve is the power button on the front. It looks great Update: After 6 months, Had a few broken clips on my ANTEC C8 Wood case and emailed support late Sunday night. To my surprise, they replied within minutes and shipped the replacement part the next day. Incredible response time and top-notch customer service—Antec really impressed me!
reviews.author: Alex Lozada

reviews.title: Makes Big Builds Feel More Manageable...and Looks Awesome!
reviews.comment: I picked up the Antec C8 Wood because I needed more room for a dual-GPU setup to split my AI workloads. Everything came packed really well, and the glass panels look great once they’re on. The walnut front actually matches my desk, which I didn’t expect. I’m running an i7-13700K, a Noctua cooler, an RTX 5080 and 4070 Ti, plus about ten case fans total. For now I’ve only tested with one GPU since I’m waiting on a new PSU, but even with half the setup running, it already feels like the right case for the job. I attached my thermals for CPU Idle, CPU Max and GPU Maxed if interested. Its a significant improvement from my old case, as stress testing gave a ton of headroom for the extra GPU. What I Like: Airflow is honestly great. With all the ARGB fans going, the whole system looks like it’s about to jump through time—but in a classy, wood-accent kind of way. Bottom intake is clever and definitely helps, though it does make my feet a little cold. Building in this thing was easier than I expected for such a big case. I didn’t have any issues with knobs falling off or anything like that. And the front-panel connection being a single plug is a lifesaver. Cable management was almost relaxing with how open the chambers are. What I Don’t Like: There’s a small gap where the two glass panels meet. It’s not terrible, but it does make me wish I’d gone for the curved version. This case is also huge—like “measure your space twice” huge. Luckily I really like it, so thankfully I don't need to return it hah. Would I Recommend It: Yes, especially if you’re running a lot of hardware or just want a clean, roomy layout without fighting cables or airflow.
reviews.author: heyviet

reviews.title: Excellent case for your PC Build
reviews.comment: The case is spacious and well thought out. There are plenty of diffrent ways to route cables with an adaquate amount of tie down points.  It is easy to remove all the panels, as there arn't any major screws holding down the side pannels or the front panel. I was able to easily remove the front panel without too much issue, as I have had with some fish tank style cases that have 8+ screews for the front glass. I have a custom water cooling loop inside and I do not have any issues with space with 2 360mm radiators. This isn't the most popular water-cooling case, but I don't think it was a necessary difficult case to build a custom loop in. I did find that my combo of radiator and reservoir had a tight curve for soft tubing. I am not sure on the best way I could have mitigated that issue, but It is fine none the less with plenty of fiddling. It is a solid looking case with a nice wood accent that feels like real wood. I didn't have any defects in my wood.
reviews.author: Layne Myers

reviews.title: buy it
reviews.comment: This case is fantastic. its solid as hell even without the glass in place. easy to build in. plenty of airflow and is large enough for even the biggest of video cards. the only thing i dont love about it is the hdd slots. you get two ssd slots but they are at the very top of the chamber and only once hdd slot at the very bottom. bneyond that though i couldnt be more impressed with the money. oh and it looks gorgeous in person. the wood is actual wood.
reviews.author: John Tyler Wittig

reviews.title: Great case and very beginner friendly to build in due to its tool-less design.
reviews.comment: I really enjoyed building in this case and yes its huge but if you have room for it then I highly recommend it. Its also easy to maintain and clean the filters. I have had it for a year and it still looks as good as new. The tool less design for removing the glass panels is great and the build quality is very high. Also the wood version looks cool and goes well with my desk aesthetics.
